notes: Twenty new badges arrive, every one counting work already in your log: 10, 25 and 50 different exercises tried, your first mobility and cardio sessions, a session note, 10 different cardio activities, 10 different weekends, 12 different months, and 26 and 52 weeks at your target
They also cover your lifetime totals: 10 and 100 hours of training, 10,000 reps, ten million kg of tonnage, a set of 5 pull-ups, a bodyweight overhead press and a 3x bodyweight deadlift
Nothing new to enter - each is derived from the log you already have; a badge you already qualify for is paid in full on the first look, by tier exactly as before
